0022600122.text: Miami, 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak, hosts the Dallas Mavericks (1-2, currently on a one-game skid) in the Heat's fourth game of the season, with Miami 5th in the Southeast and 15th in the East while Dallas is 4th in the Southwest and 12th in the West. The Mavericks are without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Cooper Flagg is day-to-day with a shoulder sprain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27 and split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 118-108 Heat loss in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
